@NumStability.leveque01_coordinateSplittingBalance_information : ∀ {D : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq D] {m : ℕ}
  {laws : D → NumStability.OneDimensionalHyperbolicConservationLaw (Fin m)}
  {Result : (d : D) → NumStability.HyperbolicRiemannProblem (laws d) → Type u_2} {Information : D → Type u_3}
  (methods : (d : D) → ℝ → NumStability.RiemannInformationFluxMethod (laws d) (Result d) (Information d))
  (cellVolume : (D → ℤ) → ℝ) (area : D → (D → ℤ) → ℝ) (fallback : D → (D → ℤ) → ℝ → (ℤ → Fin m → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ)
  (stages : List (D × ℝ)) (state : (D → ℤ) → Fin m → ℝ),
  NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.SweepAdmitted methods cellVolume area fallback stages state →
    (∀ (other : D → (D → ℤ) → ℝ → (ℤ → Fin m → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ),
        NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep cellVolume
            (NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.guardedRule methods area fallback) stages state =
          NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep cellVolume
            (NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.guardedRule methods area other) stages state) ∧
      ∀ (before : List (D × ℝ)) (d : D) (dt : ℝ) (after : List (D × ℝ)),
        stages = before ++ (d, dt) :: after →
          ∀ (cell : D → ℤ),
            have current :=
              NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep cellVolume
                (NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.guardedRule methods area fallback) before state;
            ∃ (admitted : NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.FaceAdmitted methods d dt current cell),
              let problem :=
                NumStability.adjacentCellRiemannProblem (laws d) (fun j => current (Function.update cell d j)) (cell d);
              have result := (methods d dt).solve problem admitted;
              problem.leftState = current (Function.update cell d (cell d - 1)) ∧
                problem.rightState = current cell ∧
                  NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.normalFaceFlux
                      (NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.guardedRule methods area fallback) d dt current cell =
                    area d cell • (methods d dt).numericalFlux ((methods d dt).extract result)
